stem: A telecom's mobile game backend must process input from 5G devices with the lowest possible network latency by running compute inside the telecom's own network infrastructure.

choices.text: An EC2 cluster placement group in the nearest AWS Region

rationale: AWS Wavelength embeds AWS compute and storage inside a telecom provider's 5G network, which is exactly the requirement to run compute inside the telecom's own infrastructure with the lowest latency to 5G devices. AWS Local Zones extend AWS services to AWS-operated metro locations, not into a telecom's own network. AWS Outposts brings AWS infrastructure into a customer's own facility, not a telecom's 5G network. A cluster placement group only controls proximity between instances inside a single Availability Zone in a Region; it does not move compute into the telecom's network at all.
